option.name: --interactive
tip: Interactive interface with autocompletion to select the packages to update.

option.name: --lock
tip: Overwrites the lock file hash to suppress warning about the lock file being out of date without updating package versions.
Package metadata like mirrors and URLs are updated if they changed.

option.name: --minimal-changes
tip: Only perform absolutely necessary changes to dependencies.
If packages cannot be kept at their currently locked version they are updated.
For partial updates the allow-listed packages are always updated fully.
(can also be set via the COMPOSER_MINIMAL_CHANGES=1 env var).

option.name: --no-audit
tip: Skip the audit step after updating the composer.lock file (can also be set via the COMPOSER_NO_AUDIT=1 env var).

option.name: --no-autoloader
tip: Skips autoloader generation

option.name: --no-blocking
tip: Disables all policy blocking during this command (can also be set via the COMPOSER_NO_BLOCKING=1 env var).

option.name: --no-dev
tip: Disables installation of require-dev packages.

option.name: --no-install
tip: Skip the install step after updating the composer.lock file.

option.name: --no-progress
tip: Do not output download progress.

option.name: --no-security-blocking
tip: DEPRECATED: use --no-blocking instead.
Allows installing packages with security advisories or that are abandoned (can also be set via the COMPOSER_NO_SECURITY_BLOCKING=1 env var).

option.name: --no-suggest
tip: DEPRECATED: This flag does not exist anymore.

option.name: --optimize-autoloader
tip: Optimize autoloader during autoloader dump.

option.name: --patch-only
tip: Only allow patch version updates for currently installed dependencies.

option.name: --prefer-dist
tip: Forces installation from package dist (default behavior).

option.name: --prefer-install
tip: Forces installation from package dist|source|auto (auto chooses source for dev versions, dist for the rest).

option.name: --prefer-lowest
tip: Prefer lowest versions of dependencies (can also be set via the COMPOSER_PREFER_LOWEST=1 env var).

option.name: --prefer-source
tip: Forces installation from package sources when possible, including VCS information.

option.name: --prefer-stable
tip: Prefer stable versions of dependencies (can also be set via the COMPOSER_PREFER_STABLE=1 env var).

option.name: --root-reqs
tip: Restricts the update to your first degree dependencies.

option.name: --strict-psr-autoloader
tip: Return a failed status code (6) if PSR-4 or PSR-0 mapping errors are present.
Requires --optimize-autoloader to work.

option.name: --with
tip: Temporary version constraint to add, e.g. foo/bar:1.0.0 or foo/bar=1.0.0

option.name: --with-all-dependencies
tip: Update also dependencies of packages in the argument list, including those which are root requirements (can also be set via the COMPOSER_WITH_ALL_DEPENDENCIES=1 env var).

option.name: --with-dependencies
tip: Update also dependencies of packages in the argument list, except those which are root requirements (can also be set via the COMPOSER_WITH_DEPENDENCIES=1 env var).

next.name: validate
tip: Validates a composer.json and composer.lock

option.name: --check-lock
tip: Check if lock file is up to date (even when config.lock is false)

option.name: --no-check-all
tip: Do not validate requires for overly strict/loose constraints

option.name: --no-check-lock
tip: Do not check if lock file is up to date

option.name: --no-check-publish
tip: Do not check for publish errors

option.name: --no-check-version
tip: Do not report a warning if the version field is present

option.name: --strict
tip: Return a non-zero exit code for warnings as well as errors

option.name: --with-dependencies
tip: Also validate the composer.json of all installed dependencies

global_option.name: --ansi
tip: Force ANSI output.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Display help for the given command.
When no command is given, display help for the list command.

global_option.name: --no-ansi
tip: Disable ANSI output.

global_option.name: --no-cache
tip: Prevent use of the cache.

global_option.name: --no-interaction
tip: Do not ask any interactive question.

global_option.name: --no-plugins
tip: Whether to disable plugins.

global_option.name: --no-scripts
tip: Skips the execution of all scripts defined in composer.json file.

global_option.name: --profile
tip: Display timing and memory usage information.

global_option.name: --quiet
tip: Do not output any message.

global_option.name: --verbose
tip: Increase the verbosity of messages: 1 for normal output, 2 for more verbose output and 3 for debug.

global_option.name: --version
tip: Display this application version.

global_option.name: --working-dir
tip: If specified, use the given directory as working directory.
